# HTTP API

<!-- Generated by scripts/docs/generate.ts. Do not edit by hand. -->

All browser routes live under `/api/v1` unless noted. Health and auth routes are
public; the rest require a session cookie or a bearer token. Cookie mutations
also require the `x-csrf-token` header.

## Envelopes

Success:

```json
{ "data": {}, "meta": {} }
```

Paginated lists use `{ "data": [], "meta": { "nextCursor": "…", "hasMore": true } }`.

Failure:

```json
{ "error": { "code": "FORBIDDEN", "message": "…", "details": null } }
```

## Notes

- `POST /api/v1/auth/magic-link` returns the raw token only when
  `ENVIRONMENT=development`.
- `/mcp` is a Streamable HTTP endpoint, not a JSON REST route. It accepts API
  keys, session cookies, and OAuth bearers.
- `/media/:id` is the authenticated R2 read proxy.
- This table is generated from the route modules; it lists the mounted paths,
  not every middleware branch.
